reviews.title: Great trivia game, but needs a lot more questions
reviews.text:
This is a fantastic trivia game. I’m not sure of the accuracy of the questions, but I’m not too worried about that. I’m sure the developers do their research and fix questions when reported. My issue is the amount of questions. Yes, 1,834 current questions and several category questions is a decent amount. However, once you get through them all, you have no reason to keep playing (or paying!). There are soooooooooo many things to write questions on. This app could easily have several thousand questions, at least. I’d love to see a lot more questions get added and categories too. For how, I guess I’ll cancel my subscription and wait for such an update. Farewell for now, Trivia Erudite.

EDIT: I changed my rating from 4 stars to 3 stars because I am honestly quite disappointed by the fact that only about 100 levels were added since the last update. It only went from 1,834 to 1,936. There are so many questions that could be added. Only getting 100 each update, give or take, is just not enough. I’ll wait for the next update, and if only 100 gets added I will change my rating to 2 stars. Please do better, Erudite dev team…

reviews.title: I really enjoy
reviews.text:
I really enjoy playing this game and will definitely continue! There's such a great variety of categories to choose from. I absolutely fell in love with the music levels-it's so much fun to guess familiar songs that then stick with you for the rest of the day. The game is also very educational. I've learned about foods and animals I had never heard of before.
Highly recommend it to everyone!

reviews.title: The best games I have ever played
reviews.text: This is one of the best games I have ever played! I thought no game could really draw me in but this one was a very cool exception. I really like the format of spinning circles to make matches, it's very unusual and unique. While playing I can recall things I once knew perfectly which is great because it keeps my brain constantly working. The music questions and the variety of level themes are what keep me coming back to the game every day. My wife and friends started playing too after my recommendation ;) So, I recommend it to you as well. Keep up the great work, developers!
